request.decision: For internal S5 b.2 request drivers, choose the API representation. Implementation inspected: libisf/src/request_open.h and request_open.cc (nine named drivers), libisf/src/request_driver.h (RequestSink and PumpSubmission), app/enginelink/engine_worker_edit_ops.cpp:23-353,886-927 and engine_controller.cpp:1248-1324 (nine save/export/preview/repair handlers). Existing request_open target passed on the builder; evidence .local/sdk-continuation/evidence/request-open-20261011T183548Z/summary.md. J380 design specifies internal extraction with unchanged validation, wire bytes and publication order.

options.description: Nine named internal functions plus OutputLeaseRef and the existing RequestSink seam, preserving each current handler's parameter list and body order.
Nine new request structs and a single variant dispatcher, preserving the same validation and submission behavior.

request.decision: How should the nine save/export handlers be represented inside libIsf? Existing helpers are libisf/src/request_driver.h and libisf/src/request_open.h. Existing engine requests are each a named worker function. Required behavior is fixed by tests/app/engine_controller_preview_latency_probe_save_export_classic_tests.h and tests/app/engine_controller_preview_latency_probe_save_export_field_mesh_tests.h. The b.1 baseline/restored runs pass and three deliberate byte/order/refusal defects fail in .local/sdk-continuation/evidence/s5b1-build-retry.log. Fresh existing driver-pattern test passes in .local/sdk-continuation/evidence/request-open-20261011T183548Z/summary.md. All options keep this internal and preserve existing behavior.
